method: finite-difference collocation of g_tau = -A g with A = A1 D^2; A1 is the grain-boundary elasticity operator integrated with singularity subtraction of the principal value at z=zeta (validated against an mpmath finite-part reference to 1e-13); eigenvalues from eig(-A) on uniform grids, extrapolated as 1/n -> 0; equilibrium wedge and stress intensity factor from A1 w = 1.
